title: Stale finance dashboards before the daily revenue close
domain: order data pipeline and warehouse loading
context: Order rows flow from checkout hosts through a change-data-capture stream into a validation stage and then a warehouse loader that feeds finance tables. The validation stage applies rules and routes failing rows to a quarantine table. The loader has a circuit breaker. On Sep 22 finance dashboards stopped refreshing overnight, and finance needs current tables for the 08:00 UTC daily revenue close. It is now 06:15 UTC.

entities.description: Write order rows, including order_total and currency.
Captures payments; records the amount actually charged per order.
Applies rules R1 and R2; routes failing rows to quarantine.
order_total must be between 0 and 50,000 in major currency units.
currency must appear in the currency reference list.
Table holding rows that failed a rule; rows can be released to the loader.
Halts warehouse loading while quarantined rows exceed 5% of rows in any 10-minute window.
Alerts when finance tables have not refreshed for 60 minutes.
Consumes checkout order events and accrues points from order_total.

evidence.text: Finance tables last refreshed at 02:40. The freshness monitor alerted at 03:40. The 08:00 revenue close reads these tables.
The loader circuit breaker tripped at 02:41. The quarantine rate for 02:30-02:40 was 7.9% against a 5% threshold. Loading has been halted since.
R1 failures: 11,400 rows, all written after 02:05. R2 failures: 8,300 rows, all with currency RSD, spread from 00:00 onward.
Quarantine rate per 10-minute window: 1.8-2.4% from 00:00 to 02:00; then 4.1%, 5.6%, 6.8%, and 7.9% for the windows ending 02:10, 02:20, 02:30, and 02:40.
The Serbia market launched at 00:00 with prices in RSD. The currency reference list used by R2 was last updated on Aug 30.
Checkout v9 has been running on 30% of checkout hosts as a canary since 02:05. The checkout team describes v9 as a UI refresh and says order amount handling was not changed.
200 R1-quarantined rows sampled: all were written by v9 hosts, and each order_total is exactly 100 times the amount payment-service captured for that order.

200 rows written by v9 hosts between 02:05 and 02:40 that passed validation and were loaded into finance tables: each order_total is exactly 100 times the payment-service captured amount. All 200 totals are below 50,000.
200 RSD rows sampled from quarantine: order_total equals the payment-service captured amount for every row, and payment-service records the charges in RSD.
"Validation is catching the bad rows, so nothing bad has reached finance. The breaker is the only thing blocking the close; we should switch it off."

loyalty-service accrues points from order_total on checkout order events. Those events are emitted by a different checkout code path from the one that writes order rows, and whether v9 changed that path has not been checked. Nobody has examined loyalty accruals for orders since 02:05.
Serbian daytime traffic begins around 04:00 UTC. Because the market launched at midnight, the RSD share of orders during daytime hours has not yet been observed, and no forecast exists.
The routine nightly vacuum job ran on the finance schema from 02:30 to 02:55.
A US promotion raised checkout volume by about 40% from 01:30.
On Aug 14 R2 quarantined 1,200 rows with blank currency caused by a partner-integration defect; the breaker tripped and those rows never reached finance tables.
A loader node reported 85% disk usage at 02:20; usage has not changed since.

hypotheses.text: Checkout v9 writes order_total values that are 100 times the amount charged.
Every v9 row with an incorrect order_total has been kept out of the finance tables.
The quarantined RSD rows contain incorrect order data.
With v9 removed, RSD quarantines alone would trip the breaker during Serbian daytime traffic.
RSD quarantines alone would have tripped the breaker by 02:41.

edges.from: currency reference list last updated Aug 30

edges.to: v9 rows with incorrect totals reaching finance tables
v9 rows with incorrect totals below 50,000

actions.text: Disable the loader circuit breaker so finance tables refresh before the 08:00 close.
Roll back the checkout v9 canary.
Add RSD to the currency reference list used by R2.
Raise R1's upper bound from 50,000 to 5,000,000.
Identify the v9 rows loaded between 02:05 and 02:40 and amend or withdraw them before the 08:00 close.
After RSD is on the reference list, release the quarantined RSD rows to the loader.
Postpone the nightly vacuum job on the finance schema.
